channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: O principal sinal da penúltima pesquisa Quaest sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula antes do segundo turno
item.description: The latest Quaest poll before the runoff between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula shows a technical tie (45% vs 44%) and a sharp rise in voter indecision among independents, who moved from 13% to 31% in spontaneous voting intention. According to Quaest's director of intelligence, the surge in undecided voters reflects difficulty in choosing a candidate in the final stretch but does not signal a major shift in the electoral landscape. While increased indecision might raise abstention, the competitiveness of the race could also boost turnout.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede cassação da chapa de Flávio Bolsonaro em ação sobre atuação da Meta nas eleições
item.description: Lula's campaign requests the annulment of Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket for alleged abuse of economic power and misuse of digital platforms, such as Meta and X, favoring the candidacy. The lawsuit also seeks an eight-year ban on Flávio, claiming restrictions on the reach of Lula's campaign content.

item.title: Leia todas as 19 exigências de Flávio para abrir sigilo como Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a petition with the TSE containing 19 conditions to open his privacy seals, responding to Lula's challenge during a debate on Band. The proposal includes authorization to disclose banking, fiscal, and phone privacy seals of his family and companies, plus demands to break seals of Lula's relatives and associates.

item.title: Defensoria aciona STF para obrigar transporte gratuito no 2º turno
item.description: The Public Defender's Office of the Union (DPU) filed a motion with the Supreme Federal Court (STF) requesting that states, municipalities, and the electoral courts be ordered to provide free public transportation during the second round of elections, scheduled for Sunday, the 25th. At least 78 city halls have stated they will not ensure fare-free transport nor maintain regular bus service. The lawsuit aims to guarantee voting rights, particularly for low-income voters.

item.title: Manifesto na USP defende independência dos Três Poderes
item.description: Over 700 personalities, including former STF ministers and ex-governors, read a manifesto at USP defending the independence of the Three Powers and constitutional respect. The document avoids naming Lula and Bolsonaro but warns against power concentration. The event, organized by academic and civil society groups, reinforced checks and balances in democracy.

item.title: Nunes Marques dá prazo para Flávio e aliados apagarem 20 conteúdos sobre Lula
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the removal of 20 publications by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and allied parliamentarians about Lula following a court ruling favorable to the PT coalition. The removal deadline was set at three hours.

item.title: Não é petista, é mãe: o voto de Angélica fala por milhões de mulheres
item.description: Angélica's video, stating she is not a PT supporter nor right-wing but voting for Lula, reflects the central role of women in the 2026 election amid reduced polarization. Support from figures tied to Luciano Huck's circle, including his mother, signals a traditionally right-leaning sector reconsidering its choices. Lula's candidacy gains momentum with female voters who prioritize issues like security, childhood, and minority rights.

item.title: O que as últimas pesquisas eleitorais divulgadas mostram?
item.description: Five polls released show Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula with minor variations within the margin of error. The general trend indicates fluctuations in support levels without a clear frontrunner. Comparisons should be interpreted cautiously due to changes in sampling design after the first round.

item.title: Exclusivo: governador eleito de MG fala sobre Flávio, Lula e dívida
item.description: The elected governor of Minas Gerais, Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), in an exclusive interview with columnist Ricardo Kertzman, supports Flávio Bolsonaro and counters right-wing criticism regarding negotiations with Davi Alcolumbre to end the 6×1 scale. He also responds to Lula, who claimed Minas needs him to be rebuilt, and discusses the state's billion-dollar debt.

item.title: Com André Fernandes, Flávio é recebido por multidão para ato em Fortaleza
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a rally in Fortaleza with significant crowd turnout, sharing images on social media. The Quaest survey shows a technical tie between Flávio (45%) and Lula (44%) nationally, but Lula leads strongly in the Northeast (61% vs 31%). The runoff takes place on Sunday with 43.5 million voters in the region. The event featured support from André Fernandes and Alcides Fernandes, demonstrating strong PL mobilization in the Northeast.

item.title: Willer Tomaz rebate Richarlison e diz que jogador comprou ilha de “invasor”
item.description: Lawyer Willer Tomaz responded to footballer Richarlison's claim about a mansion on Ilha Comprida allegedly being returned to PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing that the property was purchased from an 'invader'. The case involves a dispute over the legality of land transfer in a residential area. Tomaz defends the validity of his client's purchase, while Richarlison questions the origin of the property.

item.title: Estadão tem postagens sobre eleições censuradas pela Meta e recorre ao TSE
item.description: The newspaper O Estado de S. Paulo filed a lawsuit with the TSE to prevent Meta from removing journalistic posts published on Facebook and Instagram, after 31 articles were reportedly deleted without justification during the election period. They claim none of the posts constituted electoral advertising or improperly used artificial intelligence.

item.title: Edinho afirma que campanha de Lula está “muito convencida” de vitória
item.description: Edinho Silva, campaign coordinator for Lula, stated that the team is 'very convinced' of winning the 2026 second round, despite polls showing a technical tie with Flávio Bolsonaro. He emphasized campaign growth in the streets and public opinion, highlighting proposals for continuity without loss of social rights.

item.title: CNBB divulga "mensagem ao povo brasileiro" antes do 2º turno. Leia íntegra
item.description: The Brazilian Bishops' Conference (CNBB) released a message to the Brazilian people ahead of the second round of elections, reaffirming respect for the electoral results and advocating for the Constitution, the Democratic State of Law, and conscientious voter participation. The document emphasizes public policies on dignified work, food, housing, health, education, security, and environmental protection, while warning against corruption and voter coercion.

item.title: Entenda polêmica entre Richarlison, Flávio Bolsonaro e Willer Tomaz sobre posse de ilha em Angra
item.description: Richarlison accuses Flávio Bolsonaro and Willer Tomaz of illegal occupation of an island in Angra dos Reis, which the politicians deny. The legal battle has lasted since 2020 and involves money laundering charges against them. The player demands return of the property after losing court cases.

item.title: O Exército do Lula no WhatsApp pode decidir o segundo turno?
item.description: Arilton Freres, CEO of Instituto Indexa, discusses on Papo Antagonista the influence of 'Exército do Lula', a WhatsApp group with millions of subscribers led by André Janones, highlighting the PT's digital mobilization in the runoff as unprecedented. He also comments on the absence of a hidden vote in the final stretch.

item.title: Manifestantes colocam cartaz de "fora, Lula" durante ato do petista em BH
item.description: At a campaign rally in Belo Horizonte, opposing protesters hung a banner demanding Lula and the PT leave, while supporters packed the avenue with signs, balloons and the 'Eu acredito' chant, highlighting polarization in the Minas Gerais runoff.

item.title: Lula ainda pode virar? O que os números da Indexa realmente mostram
item.description: A Indexa poll released four days before the runoff shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 51% of valid votes against Lula's 49%. Institute CEO Arilton Freres told Papo Antagonista that Lula has little room to grow and that poor government evaluations weigh against re-election. While the gap is tight, a reversal is still possible depending on turnout and undecided voters.

item.title: Marqueteiro de Lula negocia checagem em tempo real no debate da “Globo”
item.description: The Minister of the Secretariat for Strategic Affairs, Sidônio Palmeira, discusses with TV Globo the implementation of real-time fact-checking during the presidential debate on October 23rd. The proposal involves publishing checks on g1 without integrating them into the live broadcast. Sidônio advocates for instant verification of statements to combat misinformation.

item.title: Presidente do TSE derruba 20 postagens contra Lula e proíbe que Flávio e aliados republiquem conteúdo
item.description: The TSE president ordered the removal of 20 fake posts attacking Lula, including one simulating a meeting between Lula and Trump using AI. Flávio Bolsonaro and allies were banned from resharing the content, facing potential electoral violations. The ruling aims to combat disinformation and misuse of AI in the electoral race.

item.title: Kassio dá 3h para remoção de 20 conteúdos contra Lula publicados nas redes
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, head of the TSE, ordered the removal of 20 social media posts attacking Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's image within 3 hours. The ruling targets publications involving figures like Flávio Bolsonaro, Mário Frias, Gustavo Gayer, and Gilvan da Federal, using AI and image manipulation to tarnish the candidate. Lula's federation claimed an organized network with over 1.4 million shared followers.

item.title: ‘Quem é Mariana?’: Eleitores relembram personagem do caso das ‘rachadinhas’ de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Mariana Mota, former chief of staff to Flávio Bolsonaro, was cited as an operator in the 'rachadinhas' scheme before Fabrício Queiroz. The Public Ministry points to her as responsible for leading the scheme and being linked to the Bolsonaro family. Voters were urged to research 'Who is Mariana' after a mention by André Janones.

item.title: PF diz que encontrou sala secreta com máquina de contar dinheiro no hangar de Willer Tomaz; veja imagens
item.description: Federal Police discovered a secret room with money-counting machines in Willer Tomaz's hangar at Brasília airport, used by aviation companies linked to the lawyer and friend of Flávio Bolsonaro. The defense claims the equipment is legitimate, but authorities investigate possible money laundering tied to INSS fraud. The case is part of the 'Sem Desconto' operation and involves parallel investigations at the Supreme Court.

item.title: Flávio não aprendeu a mamar quando criança, mas a mentir, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula harshly criticized PL candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him a liar and questioning his maturity during a campaign event in Belo Horizonte. He also associated Bolsonaro with militias and demanded the opening of banking, fiscal, and phone secrecy, while commenting on the upcoming Globo debate.

item.title: Leilão de promessas vai frustrar os desejos de mudança
item.description: Lula's reelection campaign is hindered by widespread distrust, fatigue, and an irresponsible pledge auction that undermines structural change. The opposition, led by figures like Flávio Bolsonaro, benefits from broad dissatisfaction but lacks capacity for real reforms. Judicial insecurity and the politicization of the judiciary worsen the institutional crisis.

item.title: Flávio espera TSE sobre 79 questionamentos sobre propagandas de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign awaits TSE rulings on 79 allegations concerning Lula's allies' advertisements, with 47 cases under Minister Estela Aranha, who historically votes in favor of the PT. The lawsuits allege violations such as deepfakes, irregular campaigning, and illegal online boosting, while requests for reply rights seek space for rebuttals in live streams and free TV slots. The legal battle intensifies 4 days before the second-round elections.

item.title: Lula ganha celular e diz que entrará em canal de apoiadores no zap
item.description: President Lula announced he received a phone from the governor of Piauí and stated he will join the Exército do Lula WhatsApp channel, urging supporters to help expand the base to 10 million followers by Thursday. During the event in Belo Horizonte, he highlighted backing from allies such as Alexandre Silveira and André Janones, and canceled a Record interview due to voice loss.

item.title: Mercado segue apostando em Flávio mesmo com incômodo por promessas de campanha
item.description: The financial market remains optimistic about Flávio Bolsonaro's election as president, despite criticism of his campaign promises. Asset managers believe his government would be preferable to Lula's reelection.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recusa sabatina no SBT e vai a ato com apoiadores
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, declined an interview on SBT, citing scheduling conflicts. Instead, he attended a rally with supporters the same day. His decision sparked reactions regarding candidates' engagement with the press during the election campaign.

item.title: Camilo: Há tentativa clara da Meta de impedir avanço da campanha de Lula
item.description: Senator Camilo Santana, campaign coordinator for Lula, accused Meta of trying to block the president's campaign progress on digital platforms. He highlighted actions by the company's social networks, including Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, as obstacles to Lula's communication reach. The statement was made on November 21st.

item.title: 'Quem é Mariana': entenda busca relacionada a Flávio impulsionada por Janones
item.description: A post by André Janones and the hashtag #QuemEMarianaFlavio drove searches linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the 'rachadinha' scheme at Alerj, which was closed by the Public Ministry. The strategy aims to associate the lawmaker with alleged public fund embezzlement.

item.title: Campanha de Lula diz que conversa com Globo para fact-checking em tempo real no debate de sexta
item.description: Lula's campaign is negotiating with TV Globo to include real-time fact-checking during Friday's presidential debate. The head of the presidential office's communication secretariat, Sidônio Palmeira, confirmed the broadcaster's willingness to use the tool during the live broadcast.

item.title: Defensoria pede ao STF ação urgente contra prefeitos que não garantem transporte gratuito no dia da eleição
item.description: The Brazilian Federal Public Defender's Office requested an urgent decision from the Supreme Federal Court to ensure free transportation to voters in the runoff elections. The agency claims that mayors who fail to guarantee this right may face penalties.

item.title: “Faria Limers” marcam “happy hour da vitória” em churrascaria após eleição
item.description: Investor groups are organizing a pre-victory celebration at a steakhouse for candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), anticipating his win in the 2026 election. The event runs parallel to financial market growth and electoral polarization.

item.title: Previsão inicial de renegociação no Desenrola 3.0 é de R$ 90 bilhões
item.description: The Brazilian Minister of Finance, Dario Durigan, announced that from October 21st, financial institutions can express interest in the debt auction scheduled under the Desenrola 3.0 program, with an initial estimate of R$ 90 billion in debts to be renegotiated. Despite the high amount, the maximum impact will be R$ 9 billion due to the minimum 90% discount stipulated in the Provisional Measure. The auction, expected for mid-November, will proceed regardless of the October 25th election results.

item.title: Luciano Huck chama denúncia de interferência nas eleições de "fake news"
item.description: Luciano Huck dismissed allegations of election interference by Donald Trump as 'fake news' and shared a statement from RenovaBR denying receipt of foreign funds. The TV host emphasized that the institute's executive director participated in a U.S. State Department exchange program but clarified the organization is nonpartisan and not linked to foreign governments. The controversy involves alleged attempts to influence the Brazilian electoral scenario.

item.title: No DF, Flávio tem 50% contra 39% de Lula, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on October 21, 2026, shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 50% of voting intentions in the Federal District, against 39% for Lula (PT) in the projected second round. Government approval for Lula in the DF stands at 41%, with 53% disapproving.

item.title: Coordenador de Lula diz que petista aceita condições de Flávio para abrir sigilos
item.description: Lula's campaign coordinator Camilo Santana said the PT accepts Flávio Bolsonaro's conditions to break secrecy, calling them a maneuver. The statement suggests possible progress in parliamentary cooperation.

item.title: Lula aceita exigências de Flávio e Marcola aceita abrir sigilo
item.description: Lula agrees to open financial and phone records conditionally, demanding that Flávio Bolsonaro release data on Marcola, the Lula Institute, and Alcazar Holdings. The PT campaign seeks reciprocity at the TSE ahead of the runoff.

item.title: Lula aceita condições de Flávio para ampliar quebra de sigilo, diz campanha
item.description: Lula's campaign authorizes the release of 20-year bank, tax, and phone secrecy records, conditioning this to reciprocal transparency demands on Flávio Bolsonaro. Political coordinator Camilo Santana stated that the president opposes none of the senator's requests, provided Flávio complies with the same. The scope includes data from companies owned by Lula's children and former chief of staff Marcola.

item.title: TSE: informação de que 4 mil seções mudaram de lugar estava incorreta
item.description: The TSE corrected a previous claim that 4,352 polling stations had changed location between election rounds, clarifying that the actual number is 343 stations. Authorities attributed the error to an incorrect comparison with 2024 data and failures by regional courts in updating the system. The electoral court urged voters to confirm their voting location through official channels.

item.title: Campanha de Lula diz que aceita abrir sigilo de Marcola caso Flávio Bolsonaro abra o seu
item.description: Lula's campaign agreed to unveil Marcola's records if Flávio Bolsonaro releases his own, as stated by former minister Camilo Santana.

item.title: Governo pode gastar até R$ 9 bilhões em leilão de dívidas
item.description: The federal government, through Minister of Finance Dario Durigan, announced it may spend up to R$9 billion to purchase debts from individuals and small entrepreneurs under the Desenrola 3.0 program, with minimum discounts of 90%. The initiative aims to renegotiate debts overdue by 2 to 4.5 years, prioritizing low-income debtors.

item.title: Nikolas versus Janones
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira and André Janones lead the digital strategies of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula respectively, with Nikolas focusing on Instagram and Janones on WhatsApp. Both are considered key players for digital mobilization in the 2026 elections.

item.title: PSB e PDT oficializam apoio à reeleição de Hugo Motta
item.description: The PSB and PDT officially endorsed Hugo Motta's (Republicanos) re-election as Speaker of the Chamber of Deputies, expanding support to 12 parties and further isolating the PL ahead of the February vote.

item.title: Quaest: Aumento dos indecisos em pesquisa espontânea indica voto menos convicto em meio à pancadaria
item.description: The doubling of undecided voters in the spontaneous survey reflects less committed voting amid a polarized second round between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The campaign, marked by controversies and tense debates, makes election outcomes hard to predict.

item.title: Campanha de Lula diz que aceita condições de Flávio sobre abertura de sigilo
item.description: Lula's campaign team announced acceptance of 19 conditions proposed by Flávio Bolsonaro for the release of banking and phone records. Camilo Santana stated that a formal document will be filed at the TSE, covering companies linked to the president's family and the Lula Institute.

item.title: Proposta de Mendonça não vai adiante no TSE e canais do WhatsApp funcionarão no 2º turno
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, decided not to move forward with Minister André Mendonça's proposal to restrict WhatsApp channels with over 200,000 users during the election period. The decision maintains current rules, particularly affecting the 'Exército de Lula' channel led by André Janones. The measure faced criticism from media, social networks, and part of Lula's campaign.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Gerp sobre a disputa entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula a quatro dias do segundo turno
item.description: In the latest Gerp poll, Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 53% of valid votes against Lula's 47%, within a two-point margin of error. The race remains tight, with 97% of voters reporting a decided choice. Voting takes place on Sunday, 25.

item.title: Ala do TSE acredita que big techs interferiram nas campanhas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Some TSE ministers believe big techs, particularly Meta, influenced campaign reach for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, reducing some candidates' visibility while boosting others. The TSE unanimously banned Meta from restricting content about candidates, but neither campaign was satisfied with the company's explanations. Allegations include algorithm manipulation and spread of false content, keeping dissatisfaction with big techs as a unified concern during the election.
